# Traps Encyclopedia

## Trap Types

### Mechanical Traps

| Trap | Trigger | Damage | Save | Disarm |
|------|---------|--------|------|------|--------|
| Pit | Weight | 1d6 per 10 ft | - | None |
| Spiked Pit | Weight | 1d6 per 10 ft + 1d10 | DEX | None |
| Falling Block | Pressure plate | 4d6 | DEX | Thieves Tools DC 15 |
| Poison Darts | Step | 1d4 + poison | DEX | Thieves Tools DC 15 |
| Poison Needle | Touch | 1d4 + poison | CON | Thieves Tools DC 20 |
| Scythes | Step | 4d6 | DEX | Thieves Tools DC 15 |
| Boulders | Sound/Motion | 4d6 | DEX | None |
| Rolling Log | Step | 4d6 | DEX | None |
| Collapsing Ceiling | Step | 8d6 | DEX | None |
| Ceiling Pendulum | Step | 4d6 (repeatable) | DEX | None |

### Traps by Level

| Level | Trap | Deadliness |
|--------|------|-----------|
| 1-3 | Pit, Darts, Needle | Low |
| 4-6 | Poison, Scythes, Glyphs | Medium |
| 7-9 | Complex, Magic, Fire | High |
| 10+ | Multiple, Legendary, Prismatic | Extreme |
